title: First-variation bound ∫_{B_ρ(x)}⟨ν, w⟩dμ ≤ (d/dρ) L^N(G ∩ B_ρ(x)) at a differentiability radius (Simon (5))
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N open, G ⊆ ℝ^N Lebesgue null-measurable, (μ, ν) a Gauss-Green pair for (U, G), x, w ∈ ℝ^N with |w| ≤ 1, ρ > 0 with B̄_ρ(x) ⊆ U, and d ∈ ℝ such that the function V(r) := L^N(G ∩ B_r(x)).toReal has derivative d at r = ρ. Then ∫_{B_ρ(x)} ⟨ν(y), w⟩ dμ(y) ≤ d.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U G : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet G volume → IsGaussGreenPair U G μ ν → ∀ (x w : Rn N) (ρ d : ℝ), 0 < ρ → Metric.closedBall x ρ ⊆ U → ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ ↦ (volume (G ∩ Metric.ball x r)).toReal) d ρ → ∫ y in Metric.ball x ρ, inner ℝ (ν y) w ∂μ ≤ d
